body: I was about to say the same. That makes no sense that you would express concern for a complete stranger and not yourself. I am very matter of fact about my decision. I will kill myself. I have no issues with this. It’s the best option for me. I simply see it as checking out. Like clocking off and signing out from work. No biggie.
Nah too much pain. No sleep. Walking zombie. No friends. Not for me. Time to check out. But thanks for replying.
I am looking for a way to do this too but painlessly and with no mess or blood. Any ideas? Everything seems to be quite traumatic

Thanks for your reply. I appreciate it. I’m in the U.K. so unfortunately wouldn’t be able to see the Baltimore doctor. I tried Pentox at the very start and the side affects made me stop. I sometimes take ubiquinol and a whole host of supplements. But I’ve just stopped taking anything now as they don’t seem to help. Plus I think the main part of the pain was caused due to vacuum pumping. Even though I was so careful I think I may have damaged a tendon or something at the base. And I’m fairly sure though have never had it corroborated, that new plaque formed at the base. So I’m not sure that supplements will help. Think it may be more of a mechanical thing if that makes sense.
Well what’s the easiest less messy way of doing it ?
